fragment.coverage: Marker numeric predicate only; surrounding native health store remains a typed setter result; not a binary ABI entry

native_sequence.scope: Surrounding setter store, not part of private kernel

implementation.control_policy: No FLDCW, LDMXCSR, FINIT/FNINIT or control-library call; actual ambient x87 precision/rounding applies
implementation.stack_contract: Two temporary x87 entries pushed and popped; caller entries preserved with sufficient capacity
implementation.marker_write: Existing bool requests set-to-minus-one; false means no native marker write, not clearing marker
implementation.scope_assertion: Passed: only private kernel/platform guard and marker-expression replacement; public header non-comment content unchanged

probe.reference: Prior assembly transcription of native setter prefix plus recovered shared CRT assembly, independent of new helper
probe.reference_limit: Not complete original-routine execution or original-game runtime
probe.state_detail: Entire x87 CW and MXCSR control bits unchanged; TOP and exact 11.25f/-3.5f caller-stack sentinels preserved
probe.input_coverage: Existing28 rows: finite, signed zero, least-positive subnormal request, infinity, signed qNaN/sNaN in current/request/maximum roles, two precision witnesses

emitted_assembly.review: Two float loads, qword FSUB, FXCH, FCOMIP, FSTP, SETA retained in standalone and both inline paths
emitted_assembly.control_instruction_scan: No FLDCW/LDMXCSR/FINIT/FNINIT in emitted translation unit

validation.native_callsite_verifier: Not applicable: new fragment contains no calls and report makes no new callsite claims

limits: Private typed predicate, not original object layout or complete native routine/ABI
Surrounding health write occurs before kernel in source; native write lies between its two loads
Unmasked exception/trap-resume behavior, x87 status/FIP/FDP and integer-EFLAGS parity not established
Kernel does not clear exception flags; full setter still uses other FP instruction domains around it
At least two free x87 stack entries required; overflow/underflow not separately tested
DAZ/FTZ variants and independent x87/MXCSR rounding untested; bounded matrix is not blanket IEEE proof
Getter clamp/cache and fraction precision gaps, finite byte conversion limits and callback ownership/timing remain unchanged
